kept.spine: Goods made here and goods carted in are sold from the same stalls. A buyer off the road who wants to know which is which asks a stallholder.
The yards here are full of goods bound out, and no two loads carry the same thing.
The town eats, and nobody here raises the question of food.

The Cartographer's guild in Hochhausen keeps its doors open, and the supply it works from has failed upstream. The building is sound, the skill is here, and the work waits on goods that do not reach the town.
